result.summary: Found 1 major visual layout issue: restaurant metadata is overlapping and unreadable in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: The metadata beneath “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” is visibly layered on top of itself: the estimated delivery time overlaps the delivery-fee text, making both values difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time, fee, and cuisine in a properly spaced horizontal or wrapped metadata row, and ensure sufficient vertical height/margins so labels cannot overlap.
